title: Dame Pat McGrath, Hailey Bieber’s Rhode, Cymbiotika and More Honored at 2026 Beauty Inc Awards
summary: The ceremony, held Tuesday night in New York, honored the people, products and teams in the beauty industry whose accomplishments and originality defined the year.
